mechanism: Both drugs can cause hemolysis and hematologic toxicity; foscarnet increases risk of anemia and electrolyte abnormalities while primaquine causes hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients, with additive bone marrow suppression potential.
action: Monitor complete blood count, reticulocyte count, and hemoglobin levels regularly; verify G6PD status before primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarials if possible; assess renal function closely as both drugs affect kidneys.
